lead.headline: Gordon is still benched at 4 p.m.
lead.deck: 2-5. Swap Gordon into the flex for Metcalf before Sunday, and make sure the Coker claim is in.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. At 22:05 UTC DK Metcalf is still in the flex and Ollie Gordon II is still on the bench — the same 2.2 projected points the morning brief flagged. Nothing reported since changes the call: neither is on a Wednesday or Thursday report, and Gordon has averaged about 18 touches a game since Achane's season-ending injury. The morning's other worry is settled: Stefon Diggs practised fully on Thursday and the rest tag is gone. Jalen Coker, dropped by mistake on Wednesday, plays tonight at Green Bay for nobody and sits on Chem waivers until Wednesday 4 November at 02:00. This brief cannot see pending claims, so if Coker-for-Fairbairn is not in, put it in. AVIATO project 128.1 to Guillo-tinas' 88.9, 70%.
